data.narrative:
T1 Energy, a public-stage climate and energy company that has raised over $1B, is evaluated against a peer set of four same-sector, same-stage public companies: QuantumScape ($3.6B), Enovix ($1.0B), Solid Power ($504M), and LanzaTech ($73M).

The peer-median method is the applicable triangulation approach given available data. The four-company median yields $752M, with the peer universe spanning $73M to $3.6B—a range reflecting material heterogeneity in commercial maturity and technology validation within the public battery and energy storage sector. This median is anchored by mid-market valuations (Enovix at $1.0B and Solid Power at $504M) and bounded by early-stage public LanzaTech at the low end and QuantumScape's higher valuation at the high end.

The triangulated valuation range is $639M to $865M, centered at the $752M peer median. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the four-peer comp set—particularly whether Solid Power and LanzaTech remain appropriate anchors given T1 Energy's capital raise profile—and the absence of revenue, path-to-profitability, or technology-readiness metrics in the current dataset. A single-method valuation also lacks corroboration from revenue or EBITDA multiples that would strengthen conviction in the indicated range.
